name: orbit
description: Orbit - a local-first, encrypted desktop CRM that maps your people as a relationship graph, with you at the centre.
author: Orbit

scripts.predev: npm run verify:native && npm run build:renderer && node scripts/dev-brand-electron.js
scripts.predev:watch: npm run verify:native && npm run build:renderer && node scripts/dev-brand-electron.js
scripts.prebuild: npm run rebuild:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.build:check: npm run build -- --dir --publish never && npm run smoke:packaged
scripts.release:dry: npm run build -- --publish never && npm run smoke:packaged
scripts.release:mac: node scripts/require-platform.js darwin && npm run build -- --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never && npm run smoke:packaged
scripts.release:win: node scripts/require-platform.js win32 && npm run build -- --win --arm64 --x64 --publish never && npm run smoke:packaged
